gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.blocked.points: No attribute points left: level a pillar.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.hint: Your character level is Survival, Stealth and Strength added up. Every level earns %s attribute points, and each world tier you open adds more. A respec gives them back with your perks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.legend: The bar: teal from your heritage, gold from your class, parchment from your story, white your own. The dark end past the notch waits for a higher world tier. Hearts come from eating well, not from here.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.title: Heritage
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.picked: Your heritage, once you choose it. It's for life.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.press: Press it on the left to pick it
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.lead: Your heritage gives free attribute points (see K, Attributes), a gift and a flaw. Your class comes next.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.earned_desc: Not every blood is born. Some sleep until the world wakes them. Wake this one and your children may be born to it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.variants: Born in %s looks: %s. Pick this heritage, then press Look to choose.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.title: Progress your bloodline's story?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.you_become: You will live on as %s, with the %s blood they were born to, and find a calling of your own.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.you_become_pl: You will live on as %s, and find a calling of your own.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.elder: Your old self stays behind, an elder now, and goes on living their own life. You can still ask them along for old times' sake.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.power: Your %s won't come with you. It sleeps in %s's blood and will awaken in them in time.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.things: Your things: hand them down, or leave them with your elder?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.tier.title: World Tiers
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.title: Your jobs
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.hint: Hover a job for its perks
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.about: Ask a villager about work, or pull a Help wanted notice off a bounty board. Orders come each morning, and wages are paid at dusk from the town's storehouse.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.ranks: Journeyman at %s experience, Master at %s (10 an order). Masters can take an apprentice and open a stall.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.valor.title: Valor
gui.jaymoskingdoms.valor.unbound: Dormant: Valor won't bind to ki or magic users.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.valor.powered: Held back by your power: a quarter of the growth, half the pool, no higher than Kindled.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.valor.feats.title: Feats
gui.jaymoskingdoms.belt.title: Five-Art Belt
gui.jaymoskingdoms.belt.hint: Click a slot to change it. Stay beside the post or dummy.

gui.jaymoskingdoms.rite.after: After the rite: %s days, and the omens dulled by half.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.rite.after_streak: When you turn, the trials last %s days, and the omens are dulled by half.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.rite.scar: The scar stays. No rite takes it away.
